title: Security claims and device-operation capability evidence register
classificationRule: Verified requires traceable human-reviewed evidence; Authorized Device Lab is Planned/non-operational; current device-changing controls are disabled; root is classified by semantic context, not by word alone.

capabilities.claim: Knox certification or Knox hardware integration
capabilities.evidence: Issue #63 records no Samsung certification or Knox integration evidence; public RootMaster surface disabled.
capabilities.limitation: No supported-device matrix or vendor attestation evidence.

capabilities.evidence: No device-attestation implementation or approved device evidence in this repository.
capabilities.limitation: No hardware-backed or production device-attestation executor or evidence exists.

capabilities.evidence: No independent certificate, formal assessment, or scoped production evidence exists in the repository.
capabilities.limitation: Genesis must not claim certification, validation, or compliance as current capability.

capabilities.claim: Current device-changing execution: firmware flashing, bootloader modification, FRP bypass, device rooting, exploit, fuse, or recovery operation
capabilities.evidence: The public RootMaster surface is non-operational; the policy simulation denies device-changing execution; Android sandbox demonstrations are labeled fixtures and block device/network commands.
capabilities.limitation: No verified device executor, device bridge, supported-device matrix, ownership proof, consent flow, or operation approval exists.

capabilities.evidence: No callable control remains in the public RootMaster route.
capabilities.limitation: Ordinary dependency, API, event, and data registration are non-device semantics; carrier, IMEI, EFS, NVRAM, radio, modem, or register modification has no implementation or authorization evidence.

capabilities.evidence: Repository documentation identifies AcingVaultEmulator.kt as software emulation for development.
capabilities.limitation: Not evidence of TrustZone, Secure Enclave, Knox Vault, or production hardware.

capabilities.evidence: Issue #63 and the Phase 6 audit identify unresolved claim mapping and release gates.
capabilities.limitation: Build and tests do not establish deployment or release readiness.

capabilities.claim: FIPS CTIA or compliance-level API assertion
capabilities.surface: docs CTIA_Compliance.md docs API.md API schemas
capabilities.evidence: Documentation and API field occurrences are not certification or compliance evidence.
capabilities.limitation: No official FIPS, CTIA, or scoped compliance certificate exists.

capabilities.evidence: Repository text and policy references are not an independent compliance assessment.
capabilities.limitation: FIPS or compliance wording must be target/planned only until official evidence exists.
Terminology does not prove algorithm use or security level.

capabilities.evidence: TriDAR is planned Genesis architecture; required external hardware/platform dependencies are not available in this repository.
capabilities.limitation: No local deployed TriDAR capability or hardware evidence exists.

capabilities.evidence: Sentinel Mesh is planned Genesis architecture; required external platform dependencies are not available in this repository.
capabilities.limitation: No local deployed Sentinel Mesh capability or production evidence exists.

capabilities.claim: Firmware validation or firmware security evidence
capabilities.evidence: Metadata validators are non-device validation helpers; Android sandbox firmware text is a labeled fixture, not firmware evidence.
capabilities.limitation: Metadata validator output and fixtures are not device attestation, firmware verification, or device-operation evidence.

capabilities.evidence: Android and operator surfaces provide non-operational simulation/demo behavior only; current device-changing controls are disabled.
capabilities.limitation: No production operator capability or verified device executor is established.

capabilities.claim: Fabricated identifiers device results or security fixtures
capabilities.evidence: Fixture and test context must be explicit
capabilities.limitation: Fixture values must never be production evidence.

capabilities.claim: Authorized Device Lab supported device-management and rooting workflow
capabilities.evidence: Product decision defines a future Authorized Device Lab; no verified executor, device bridge, supported-device matrix, or operation evidence is present.
capabilities.limitation: Planned/non-operational. Public device-changing controls remain disabled until all governance, safety, audit, recovery, and independent validation gates are approved.
